about: The heading of a Gospel reading from Saint Matthew. Sequéntia means the continuation: the passage is read from the course of the Gospel, not from its opening verses. The 1962 Roman Missal prints it over the Gospels of the Second Sunday of Advent, of the First Sunday of Lent, of the feast of the Most Holy Trinity and of All Saints, among many other Masses.

s01.translation: The continuation of the holy Gospel according to Matthew
